<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0">
<title>폭염작업 현황 지도</title>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
body{font-family:'Malgun Gothic','맑은 고딕',sans-serif;background:#1e2a3a;color:#eee;font-size:13px;height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}
.hd{background:#0f1e30;padding:10px 18px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;border-bottom:1px solid #2a3f55;flex-shrink:0}
.hd h1{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:#fff}.hd .sub{font-size:11px;color:#7a9ab5;margin-top:1px}
.api-bar{background:#1a2f44;border-bottom:1px solid #2a3f55;padding:8px 18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;flex-shrink:0}
.api-bar label{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:#f0c040;white-space:nowrap}
.api-bar input{flex:1;min-width:200px;max-width:360px;padding:5px 10px;border:1px solid #3a5570;border-radius:5px;font-size:12px;font-family:monospace;background:#0f1e30;color:#fff}
.api-bar input::placeholder{color:#5a7a95}
.btn-s{padding:5px 13px;background:#1a5a9a;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px}
.btn-s:hover{background:#2070bb}
.hint{font-size:11px;color:#7a9ab5}
.tb{background:#162535;border-bottom:1px solid #2a3f55;padding:7px 18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;flex-shrink:0}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:5px 13px;border:1px solid #3a5570;border-radius:5px;background:#1a2f44;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#cce}
.btn:hover{background:#243f58}
.bp{background:#1a5a9a;color:#fff;border-color:#1a5a9a}.bp:hover{background:#2070bb}
.bp:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}
.bc{background:#1a6e3a;color:#fff;border-color:#1a6e3a}.bc:hover{background:#228048}
.main{display:flex;flex:1;min-height:0}
.mp{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:10px;gap:8px;min-width:0;position:relative}
.mw{flex:1;background:#0f1e30;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #2a3f55;overflow:hidden;position:relative;min-height:0}
#svg-main{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
/* 인셋 박스들 */
.inset-box{position:absolute;background:#0f1e30;border:1px solid #3a5570;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden}
#inset-jeju{bottom:60px;left:10px;width:190px;height:108px}
#inset-ulleung{bottom:60px;left:206px;width:96px;height:96px}
.inset-label{position:absolute;bottom:2px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-size:9px;color:#7a9ab5;pointer-events:none}
#map3d-main{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
#map3d-jeju,#map3d-ulleung{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.leg{background:#162535;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid #2a3f55;padding:8px 12px;flex-shrink:0}
.leg-t{font-size:10px;font-weight:600;color:#9ab5cc;margin-bottom:5px}
.leg-g{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.leg-r{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:10px;color:#c0d5e8}
.leg-b{width:14px;height:10px;border-radius:2px;flex-shrink:0}
.rp{width:330px;flex-shrink:0;background:#162535;border-left:1px solid #2a3f55;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0}
.ph{padding:10px 13px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #2a3f55;flex-shrink:0}
.ph h3{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#fff}
.sg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px;padding:9px 13px;border-bottom:1px solid #2a3f55;flex-shrink:0}
.sc{background:#1e3348;border-radius:5px;padding:7px 9px;text-align:center}
.sv{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;color:#5ab4e8}.sv.r{color:#e06666}
.sl{font-size:10px;color:#7a9ab5;margin-top:1px}
.ts{flex:1;overflow-y:auto}
@page{size:A4 landscape;margin:4mm}
@media print{
  html,body{width:100%!important;height:202mm!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important;background:#fff!important;color:#000!important;overflow:hidden!important;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact!important;print-color-adjust:exact!important}
  .api-bar,.tb,.rp,.sbar,.tip{display:none!important}
  .hd{display:none!important}
  .print-header{display:flex!important;height:10mm!important;background:#1a3a5c!important;padding:2mm 4mm!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:space-between!important;color:#fff!important;font-weight:700!important;line-height:1.15!important;flex-shrink:0!important;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact!important;print-color-adjust:exact!important}
  .print-title{font-size:15px!important;letter-spacing:-.03em!important;white-space:nowrap!important}
  .print-meta{font-size:9.5px!important;font-weight:600!important;opacity:.92!important;text-align:right!important;white-space:nowrap!important}
  .main{display:flex!important;width:100%!important;height:192mm!important;min-height:0!important;overflow:hidden!important}
  .mp{padding:0!important;gap:0!important;display:block!important;width:100%!important;height:192mm!important;position:relative!important;overflow:hidden!important;flex:1 1 auto!important}
  .mw{border:none!important;border-radius:0!important;width:100%!important;height:192mm!important;min-height:0!important;position:relative!important;overflow:hidden!important;background:#fff!important}
  #svg-main{width:100%!important;height:100%!important;display:block!important;transform:scale(1.16)!important;transform-origin:center 48%!important}
  .map-logo{top:3mm!important;left:3mm!important;width:78px!important;height:27px!important;padding:2px 5px!important;box-shadow:none!important;border-color:#bbb!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.96)!important;z-index:30!important}
  .map-logo img{width:68px!important;max-width:68px!important;max-height:18px!important}
  #inset-jeju{top:15mm!important;left:3mm!important;bottom:auto!important;width:138px!important;height:80px!important;z-index:25!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.96)!important;border:1px solid #999!important}
  #inset-ulleung{top:15mm!important;left:146px!important;bottom:auto!important;width:66px!important;height:66px!important;z-index:25!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.96)!important;border:1px solid #999!important}
  .inset-label{color:#333!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.7)!important;font-size:8.5px!important;font-weight:700!important}
  .leg{position:absolute!important;bottom:0!important;left:0!important;right:0!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.95)!important;border-top:1px solid #aaa!important;border-left:none!important;border-right:none!important;border-bottom:none!important;border-radius:0!important;padding:4px 8px!important;margin:0!important;z-index:20!important;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact!important;print-color-adjust:exact!important}
  .leg-t{font-size:9px!important;color:#111!important;margin-bottom:3px!important;font-weight:800!important}
  .leg-g{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.15fr 1.25fr 1.3fr 1.35fr .55fr!important;gap:5px!important;align-items:start!important}
  .leg-r{display:flex!important;align-items:flex-start!important;gap:4px!important;font-size:7.7px!important;color:#222!important;min-width:0!important;line-height:1.25!important}
  .leg-b{width:11px!important;height:9px!important;border-radius:2px!important;flex-shrink:0!important;margin-top:1px!important;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact!important;print-color-adjust:exact!important}
  .leg-detail{font-size:7px!important;color:#444!important;line-height:1.3!important;margin-top:1px!important}
  .leg-detail b,.leg-r b{color:#111!important}
}
.ts::-webkit-scrollbar{width:4px}.ts::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:#1e2a3a}.ts::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#3a5570;border-radius:2px}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}
th{background:#1e3348;padding:7px 8px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;color:#7a9ab5;border-bottom:1px solid #2a3f55;position:sticky;top:0;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap}
td{padding:6px 8px;font-size:11px;border-bottom:1px solid #1e2a3a;text-align:center;vertical-align:middle;color:#c0d5e8}
tr:hover td{background:#1e3348}
.tn{text-align:left;font-weight:600;color:#fff}
.badge{display:inline-block;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:8px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
.b0{background:#1a3a1a;color:#7ec87e}.b1{background:#3a3000;color:#f0c040}
.b2{background:#3a1010;color:#e08080}.b3{background:#5a0808;color:#ffaaaa}.b4{background:#b00020;color:#fff}
.h0{color:#7ec87e;font-weight:700}.h1{color:#f0c040;font-weight:700}
.h2{color:#e06666;font-weight:700}.h3{color:#ff8888;font-weight:700}.h4{color:#ff7777;font-weight:800}
.em{padding:30px 14px;text-align:center;color:#5a7a95;font-size:12px}
.sbar{background:#0f1e30;border-top:1px solid #2a3f55;padding:4px 18px;font-size:10px;color:#5a7a95;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-shrink:0}
.tip{position:fixed;background:rgba(5,15,30,.95);color:#e0eeff;border-radius:7px;padding:9px 13px;font-size:12px;pointer-events:none;display:none;max-width:210px;line-height:1.7;z-index:9999;border:1px solid #2a4f70}
.print-header{display:none}
.leg-detail{font-size:9.5px;color:#7a9ab5;margin-top:2px;line-height:1.5}
.leg-detail b{color:#aac8e0}

/* ===== UI 수정: 화면 배경 라이트 테마 ===== */
:root{
  --ui-bg:#ffffff;
  --ui-surface:#ffffff;
  --ui-surface-2:#f8fafc;
  --ui-border:#d8e1ec;
  --ui-border-2:#c7d3df;
  --ui-text:#1f2937;
  --ui-muted:#64748b;
  --ui-muted-2:#475569;
}

body{
  background:var(--ui-bg)!important;
  color:var(--ui-text)!important;
}

.hd,
.api-bar,
.tb,
.mp,
.mw,
.leg,
.rp,
.ph,
.sg,
.sc,
.sbar{
  background:var(--ui-surface)!important;
  color:var(--ui-text)!important;
  border-color:var(--ui-border)!important;
}

.hd{
  box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(15,23,42,.04)!important;
}

.hd h1,
.ph h3,
.tn{
  color:#111827!important;
}

.hd .sub,
.hint,
.sl,
#clock,
#lu,
.sbar,
.inset-label,
.leg-t,
.leg-r,
.leg-detail,
.em{
  color:var(--ui-muted)!important;
}

.api-bar label,
#basetime-display{
  color:#9a6b00!important;
}

.api-bar input{
  background:#fff!important;
  color:#111827!important;
  border-color:var(--ui-border-2)!important;
}

.api-bar input::placeholder{
  color:#94a3b8!important;
}

.btn{
  background:var(--ui-surface-2)!important;
  color:#263447!important;
  border-color:var(--ui-border-2)!important;
}

.btn:hover{
  background:#eef4fa!important;
}

.bp{
  background:#1a5a9a!important;
  color:#fff!important;
  border-color:#1a5a9a!important;
}

.bp:hover{
  background:#2070bb!important;
}

.bc{
  background:#1a6e3a!important;
  color:#fff!important;
  border-color:#1a6e3a!important;
}

.bc:hover{
  background:#228048!important;
}

.inset-box{
  background:#fff!important;
  border-color:var(--ui-border-2)!important;
}

table{
  background:#fff!important;
}

th{
  background:#f1f5f9!important;
  color:var(--ui-muted-2)!important;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--ui-border)!important;
}

td{
  color:#334155!important;
  border-bottom:1px solid #edf2f7!important;
}

tr:hover td{
  background:#f8fafc!important;
}

.sc{
  background:#f8fafc!important;
}

.ts::-webkit-scrollbar-track{
  background:#eef3f7!important;
}

.ts::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{
  background:#cbd5e1!important;
}

.tip{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.97)!important;
  color:#1f2937!important;
  border-color:var(--ui-border-2)!important;
  box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(15,23,42,.14)!important;
}

.leg-detail b,
.leg-r b{
  color:#1f2937!important;
}


/* === logo hard-size fix === */
.logo-badge{
  width:96px!important;
  height:34px!important;
  padding:3px 6px!important;
  overflow:hidden!important;
  flex:0 0 auto!important;
}
.logo-badge img{
  width:84px!important;
  max-width:84px!important;
  height:auto!important;
  max-height:24px!important;
  object-fit:contain!important;
}
@media print{
  .logo-badge{
    width:82px!important;
    height:28px!important;
    padding:2px 5px!important;
  }
  .logo-badge img{
    width:72px!important;
    max-width:72px!important;
    max-height:20px!important;
  }
}


/* === forecast 기준 문구 디자인 개선 === */
.tb{
  gap:10px!important;
  align-items:center!important;
}
.forecast-pill{
  display:inline-flex!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  gap:8px!important;
  padding:8px 14px!important;
  border:1px solid #bfdbfe!important;
  border-radius:999px!important;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#eff6ff 0%,#dbeafe 100%)!important;
  color:#0f172a!important;
  font-size:14px!important;
  line-height:1!important;
  font-weight:700!important;
  white-space:nowrap!important;
  box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(15,23,42,.08)!important;
}
.forecast-pill .fp-k{
  color:#2563eb!important;
  font-size:12px!important;
  font-weight:800!important;
  letter-spacing:-.02em!important;
}
.forecast-pill strong{
  color:#111827!important;
  font-size:14px!important;
  font-weight:800!important;
  letter-spacing:-.02em!important;
}
.forecast-pill .fp-sep{
  color:#93c5fd!important;
  font-weight:800!important;
  margin:0 1px!important;
}
.base-display{
  display:inline-block!important;
  padding:4px 9px!important;
  border:1px solid #fde68a!important;
  border-radius:999px!important;
  background:#fffbeb!important;
  color:#92400e!important;
  font-size:12px!important;
  font-weight:800!important;
  white-space:nowrap!important;
}

.time-label{
  display:inline-flex!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  gap:4px!important;
  font-size:12px!important;
  font-weight:800!important;
  color:#334155!important;
  white-space:nowrap!important;
}
.time-select{
  height:31px!important;
  padding:0 9px!important;
  border:1px solid #c7d3df!important;
  border-radius:7px!important;
  background:#fff!important;
  color:#111827!important;
  font-size:12px!important;
  font-weight:800!important;
  outline:none!important;
}
.time-select:focus{
  border-color:#1a5a9a!important;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(26,90,154,.12)!important;
}
@media (max-width:1100px){
  .forecast-pill{
    order:4!important;
    width:100%!important;
    justify-content:center!important;
    font-size:13px!important;
  }
  .forecast-pill strong{font-size:13px!important}
}
@media print{
  .forecast-pill{
    display:none!important;
  }
  .base-display{
    display:inline-block!important;
    font-size:9px!important;
    padding:2px 6px!important;
  }
}


/* === map corner logo placement fix === */
.hd-right{gap:6px!important}
.map-logo{position:absolute!important;top:10px!important;left:10px!important;z-index:20!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;width:88px!important;height:32px!important;padding:3px 6px!important;overflow:hidden!important;border:1px solid #dbe3ea!important;border-radius:8px!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.94)!important;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(15,23,42,.10)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(2px)!important}
.map-logo img{display:block!important;width:76px!important;max-width:76px!important;max-height:20px!important;height:auto!important;object-fit:contain!important}
.logo-badge{display:none!important}
@media print{
  .map-logo{top:8px!important;left:8px!important;width:76px!important;height:28px!important;padding:2px 5px!important;box-shadow:none!important;border-color:#bbb!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.96)!important}
  .map-logo img{width:66px!important;max-width:66px!important;max-height:18px!important}
}



/* === 폭염 유의사항 가독성 개선 === */
.leg{
  padding:12px 16px!important;
}
.leg-t{
  font-size:15px!important;
  font-weight:900!important;
  color:#111827!important;
  margin-bottom:8px!important;
  letter-spacing:-.03em!important;
}
.leg-t::before{
  content:'⚠️';
  margin-right:6px;
}
.leg-r{
  font-size:12px!important;
  line-height:1.45!important;
  font-weight:700!important;
  color:#263447!important;
}
.leg-detail{
  font-size:11px!important;
  line-height:1.45!important;
  color:#475569!important;
  margin-top:2px!important;
}
.leg-b{
  width:18px!important;
  height:13px!important;
  margin-top:2px!important;
}
@media print{
  .leg{
    padding:5px 9px!important;
  }
  .leg-t{
    font-size:11.5px!important;
    margin-bottom:4px!important;
    color:#111!important;
    font-weight:900!important;
  }
  .leg-g{
    grid-template-columns:1fr 1.18fr 1.35fr 1.25fr 1.2fr .55fr!important;
    gap:6px!important;
  }
  .leg-r{
    font-size:8.8px!important;
    line-height:1.28!important;
    font-weight:800!important;
  }
  .leg-detail{
    font-size:7.9px!important;
    line-height:1.28!important;
    color:#333!important;
    margin-top:1px!important;
  }
  .leg-b{
    width:13px!important;
    height:10px!important;
    margin-top:1px!important;
  }
}



/* === 인쇄용 상단 중앙 로고 보정 === */
.print-logo-center{display:none!important;}
@media print{
  .print-header{
    position:relative!important;
    height:13mm!important;
    padding:2.5mm 4mm!important;
  }
  .print-title{
    max-width:38%!important;
    overflow:hidden!important;
    text-overflow:ellipsis!important;
  }
  .print-meta{
    max-width:38%!important;
  }
  .print-logo-center{
    display:flex!important;
    position:absolute!important;
    left:50%!important;
    top:50%!important;
    transform:translate(-50%,-50%)!important;
    align-items:center!important;
    justify-content:center!important;
    width:128px!important;
    height:38px!important;
    padding:3px 8px!important;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.96)!important;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.70)!important;
    border-radius:8px!important;
    box-shadow:none!important;
    z-index:50!important;
    overflow:hidden!important;
    -webkit-print-color-adjust:exact!important;
    print-color-adjust:exact!important;
  }
  .print-logo-center img{
    display:block!important;
    width:112px!important;
    max-width:112px!important;
    max-height:28px!important;
    height:auto!important;
    object-fit:contain!important;
  }
  .map-logo{display:none!important;}
  .main{height:189mm!important;}
  .mp{height:189mm!important;}
  .mw{height:189mm!important;}
}



/* === 긴급 수정: 인쇄 시 지도 오른쪽 잘림 방지 === */
@media print{
  .mw{
    overflow:hidden!important;
  }
  #svg-main{
    width:95%!important;
    height:96.5%!important;
    margin-left:2.5%!important;
    margin-right:2.5%!important;
    margin-top:1mm!important;
    display:block!important;
    transform:scale(1.05)!important;
    transform-origin:center 49%!important;
  }
  #inset-jeju{
    width:126px!important;
    height:73px!important;
    left:3mm!important;
  }
  #inset-ulleung{
    width:60px!important;
    height:60px!important;
    left:134px!important;
  }
}

</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="hd">
  <div><h1>🌡 폭염작업 현황 대시보드</h1><div class="sub">충청·호남·대구(경북)·부산(경남) 권역별 시군구 + 제주·울릉도 | 기상청 단기예보 API</div></div>
  <div class="hd-right">
    <div class="hd-meta">
      <span id="clock" style="font-size:11px;color:#7a9ab5"></span>
      <span id="basetime-display" class="base-display" style="display:none"></span>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="print-header"><span id="ph-title" class="print-title">일일 기상 현황(폭염)</span><span class="print-logo-center"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="KT MOS 남부 로고"></span><span id="ph-time" class="print-meta">조회 전 · 예보일 예보 · 최신 발표자료 기준</span></div>
<div class="api-bar" id="apiBar">
  <label>🔑 API 키:</label>

let KEY='',DATA=[],RAW_DATA=[],SELECTED_TIME='1400';
const HOURLY_HOURS=['0900','1000','1100','1200','1300','1400','1500','1600','1700','1800'];
const REGION_ORDER=['충청','호남','대구(경북)','부산(경남)'];
function regionRank(region){
  const idx=REGION_ORDER.indexOf(region);
  return idx===-1?99:idx;
}


function getColor(hi){
  if(hi===null)return '#e5e9ef'; // 미조회
  if(hi>=38)return '#e53935';    // 위험 - 빨간색
  if(hi>=35)return '#fb8c00';    // 경고 - 주황색
  if(hi>=33)return '#ffd93d';    // 주의 - 노란색
  if(hi>=31)return '#8ecae6';    // 관심 - 하늘색
  return '#ffffff';              // 해당없음 - 흰색
}
function getStroke(hi){
  if(hi===null)return '#c7d2dd'; // 미조회
  if(hi>=38)return '#c62828';    // 위험
  if(hi>=35)return '#e07b00';    // 경고
  if(hi>=33)return '#e6b800';    // 주의
  if(hi>=31)return '#4facd4';    // 관심
  return '#c7d2dd';              // 해당없음
}
function getLevel(hi){
  if(hi>=38)return{label:'폭염중대경보',bc:'b4',hc:'h4',act:'긴급조치 외 중지 권고'};
  if(hi>=35)return{label:'폭염경보',bc:'b3',hc:'h3',act:'무더위 시간대 중지 권고 유의'};
  if(hi>=33)return{label:'폭염주의보',bc:'b2',hc:'h2',act:'작업시간 조정·옥외작업 단축 / 2시간 이내 20분 이상 휴식'};
  if(hi>=31)return{label:'예방조치',bc:'b1',hc:'h1',act:'물·그늘·휴식 확보 / 온습도 확인'};
  return         {label:'정상',    bc:'b0',hc:'h0',act:'일반 작업 가능'};
}

// 좌표 → SVG px 변환 (Mercator)
function makeProjector(regions, svgW, svgH, padPct=0.02){
  let minX=999,maxX=-999,minY=999,maxY=-999;
  for(const r of regions){
    for(const poly of r.polys)
      for(const ring of poly)
        for(const pt of ring){
          if(pt[0]<minX)minX=pt[0];if(pt[0]>maxX)maxX=pt[0];
          if(pt[1]<minY)minY=pt[1];if(pt[1]>maxY)maxY=pt[1];
        }
  }
  const toM=l=>Math.log(Math.tan(Math.PI/4+l*Math.PI/360));
  const mTop=toM(maxY), mBot=toM(minY);
  const padX=(maxX-minX)*padPct, padY=(mTop-mBot)*padPct;
  return (lon,lat)=>{
    const x=(lon-minX+padX)/(maxX-minX+padX*2)*svgW;
    const my=toM(lat);
    const y=(1-(my-mBot+padY)/(mTop-mBot+padY*2))*svgH;
    return{x,y};
  };
}

/* ===================== 3D 지도 엔진 (Three.js) ===================== */
const MAP3D_PANELS = {};

function computeBounds3D(regions){
  let minX=1e9,maxX=-1e9,minY=1e9,maxY=-1e9;
  for(const r of regions) for(const poly of r.polys) for(const ring of poly) for(const pt of ring){
    if(pt[0]<minX)minX=pt[0]; if(pt[0]>maxX)maxX=pt[0];
    if(pt[1]<minY)minY=pt[1]; if(pt[1]>maxY)maxY=pt[1];
  }
  return {minX,maxX,minY,maxY};
}
function makeProjector3D(regions, target){
  const b=computeBounds3D(regions);
  const cx=(b.minX+b.maxX)/2, cy=(b.minY+b.maxY)/2;
  const scaleLat=Math.cos(cy*Math.PI/180);
  const w=(b.maxX-b.minX)*scaleLat, h=(b.maxY-b.minY);
  const s=target/Math.max(w,h,0.0001);
  return (lon,lat)=>({x:(lon-cx)*scaleLat*s, y:(lat-cy)*s});
}

function makeDynamicSprite3D(initialText, fontSize){
  const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');
  const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
  function render(text){
    ctx.font=`700 ${fontSize}px 'Malgun Gothic',sans-serif`;
    const padX=14;
    const tw=Math.ceil(ctx.measureText(text).width);
    const w=tw+padX*2, h=fontSize+18;
    canvas.width=w*2; canvas.height=h*2;
    ctx.scale(2,2);
    ctx.font=`700 ${fontSize}px 'Malgun Gothic',sans-serif`;
    ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,14,20,0.68)';
    const r=7;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(r,0);ctx.arcTo(w,0,w,h,r);ctx.arcTo(w,h,0,h,r);ctx.arcTo(0,h,0,0,r);ctx.arcTo(0,0,w,0,r);
    ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#f2f5f8';
    ctx.fillText(text,w/2,h/2+1);
    return {w,h};
  }
  const dims=render(initialText);
  const tex=new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
  tex.minFilter=THREE.LinearFilter;
  const mat=new THREE.SpriteMaterial({map:tex, depthTest:true, depthWrite:false, transparent:true});
  const sprite=new THREE.Sprite(mat);
  sprite.scale.set(dims.w*0.34, dims.h*0.34, 1);
  return {
    sprite,
    setText(text){
      const d=render(text);
      sprite.scale.set(d.w*0.34, d.h*0.34, 1);
      tex.needsUpdate=true;
    }
  };
}

function initPanel3D(mountId, regions, opts){
  const mount=document.getElementById(mountId);
  if(!mount) return null;
  const W=()=>mount.clientWidth||opts.baseRadius, H=()=>mount.clientHeight||opts.baseRadius;
  const scene=new THREE.Scene();
  scene.background=new THREE.Color(0x0d1117);
  scene.fog=new THREE.Fog(0x0d1117, opts.fogNear, opts.fogFar);
  const camera=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(42, W()/H(), 1, 6000);
  const renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true});
  renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio,2));
  renderer.setSize(W(),H());
  renderer.shadowMap.enabled=true;
  renderer.shadowMap.type=THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
  mount.innerHTML=''; mount.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

  const hemi=new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xbfd4ff,0x1a1f28,0.7); scene.add(hemi);
  const sun=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff,1.05);
  sun.position.set(opts.sun[0],opts.sun[1],opts.sun[2]);
  sun.castShadow=true; sun.shadow.mapSize.set(1024,1024);
  const fs=opts.fogFar*0.6;
  sun.shadow.camera.left=-fs; sun.shadow.camera.right=fs; sun.shadow.camera.top=fs; sun.shadow.camera.bottom=-fs;
  sun.shadow.camera.near=10; sun.shadow.camera.far=opts.fogFar*2; sun.shadow.bias=-0.0018;
  scene.add(sun);
  const fill=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x88a0ff,0.22);
  fill.position.set(-opts.sun[0],opts.sun[1]*0.6,-opts.sun[2]);
  scene.add(fill);

  const root=new THREE.Group(); scene.add(root);
  const base=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(opts.baseRadius,64), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x141a24,roughness:1}));
  base.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2; base.position.y=-2; base.receiveShadow=true; root.add(base);
  const grid=new THREE.PolarGridHelper(opts.baseRadius,8,5,48,0x2a3340,0x1c2330);
  grid.position.y=-1.8; root.add(grid);

  const proj=makeProjector3D(regions, opts.target);
  const HEIGHT=opts.height;
  const raycastTargets=[];
  const registry={};

  regions.forEach(r=>{
    const baseColor=new THREE.Color(getColor(null));
    const topMat=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:baseColor, roughness:0.75, metalness:0.05, side:THREE.DoubleSide});
    const sideMat=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:baseColor.clone().multiplyScalar(0.72), roughness:0.9, metalness:0.02, side:THREE.DoubleSide});
    const entry={meshes:[], topMat, sideMat, baseColor, baseDepth:HEIGHT, nameCtl:null, tempCtl:null};
    registry[r.name]=entry;

    r.polys.forEach(rings=>{
      if(!rings || !rings.length || rings[0].length<3) return;
      const outer=rings[0];
      const shape=new THREE.Shape();
      outer.forEach((pt,i)=>{
        const p=proj(pt[0],pt[1]);
        if(i===0) shape.moveTo(p.x,p.y); else shape.lineTo(p.x,p.y);
      });
      shape.closePath();
      for(let hidx=1; hidx<rings.length; hidx++){
        const holePts=rings[hidx];
        if(!holePts || holePts.length<3) continue;
        const hole=new THREE.Path();
        holePts.forEach((pt,i)=>{
          const p=proj(pt[0],pt[1]);
          if(i===0) hole.moveTo(p.x,p.y); else hole.lineTo(p.x,p.y);
        });
        hole.closePath();
        shape.holes.push(hole);
      }
      let geo;
      try{
        geo=new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape,{depth:HEIGHT,bevelEnabled:true,bevelThickness:opts.bevel,bevelSize:opts.bevel,bevelSegments:2,steps:1});
      }catch(e){
        geo=new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape,{depth:HEIGHT,bevelEnabled:false,steps:1});
      }
      geo.rotateX(-Math.PI/2);
      const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,[topMat,sideMat]);
      mesh.castShadow=true; mesh.receiveShadow=true;
      mesh.userData.name=r.name; mesh.userData.region=r.region;
      mesh.userData.topMat=topMat; mesh.userData.baseColor=baseColor;
      root.add(mesh); raycastTargets.push(mesh); entry.meshes.push(mesh);
    });

    const cp=proj(r.center[0], r.center[1]);
    const nameCtl=makeDynamicSprite3D(r.name, opts.fontSize);
    nameCtl.sprite.position.set(cp.x, HEIGHT+8, -cp.y);
    nameCtl.sprite.renderOrder=2;
    root.add(nameCtl.sprite);
    entry.nameCtl=nameCtl;

    const tempCtl=makeDynamicSprite3D('', Math.max(opts.fontSize-4,13));
    tempCtl.sprite.visible=false;
    tempCtl.sprite.position.set(cp.x, HEIGHT-6, -cp.y);
    tempCtl.sprite.renderOrder=2;
    root.add(tempCtl.sprite);
    entry.tempCtl=tempCtl;
    entry.center=cp;
  });

  let radius=opts.radius, theta=opts.theta, phi=opts.phi;
  const camTarget=new THREE.Vector3(0,0,0);
  function updateCam(){
    camera.position.x=camTarget.x+radius*Math.sin(phi)*Math.sin(theta);
    camera.position.y=camTarget.y+radius*Math.cos(phi);
    camera.position.z=camTarget.z+radius*Math.sin(phi)*Math.cos(theta);
    camera.lookAt(camTarget);
  }
  updateCam();

  let dragging=false,lastX=0,lastY=0;
  const dom=renderer.domElement;
  dom.style.touchAction='none';
  dom.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{dragging=true;lastX=e.clientX;lastY=e.clientY;});
  window.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
    if(!dragging) return;
    const dx=e.clientX-lastX, dy=e.clientY-lastY;
    lastX=e.clientX; lastY=e.clientY;
    theta-=dx*0.006; phi-=dy*0.005;
    phi=Math.max(0.15,Math.min(1.35,phi));
    updateCam();
  });
  window.addEventListener('pointerup',()=>dragging=false);
  dom.addEventListener('wheel',e=>{
    e.preventDefault();
    radius+=e.deltaY*(opts.radius*0.0006);
    radius=Math.max(opts.radius*0.35,Math.min(opts.radius*2.2,radius));
    updateCam();
  },{passive:false});

  const raycaster=new THREE.Raycaster();
  const mouseNDC=new THREE.Vector2();
  const tip=document.getElementById('tip');
  let hovered=null;
  function setHi(mesh,on){
    if(!mesh) return;
    const c=mesh.userData.baseColor.clone();
    if(on) c.multiplyScalar(1.3);
    mesh.userData.topMat.color.copy(c);
  }
  function pick(cx,cy){
    const rect=dom.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouseNDC.x=((cx-rect.left)/rect.width)*2-1;
    mouseNDC.y=-((cy-rect.top)/rect.height)*2+1;
    raycaster.setFromCamera(mouseNDC,camera);
    const hits=raycaster.intersectObjects(raycastTargets);
    return hits.length?hits[0].object:null;
  }
  dom.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
    if(dragging){ tip.style.display='none'; return; }
    const obj=pick(e.clientX,e.clientY);
    if(obj!==hovered){ if(hovered) setHi(hovered,false); hovered=obj; if(hovered) setHi(hovered,true); }
    if(obj){
      tip.style.display='block';
      tip.style.left=(e.clientX+14)+'px';
      tip.style.top=(e.clientY-8)+'px';
      const d=obj.userData.__data;
      if(d){
        const lv=getLevel(d.hi);
        const col=d.hi>=38?'#ff7777':d.hi>=35?'#ff8888':d.hi>=33?'#e08080':d.hi>=31?'#f0c040':'#7ec87e';
        tip.innerHTML=`<b>${obj.userData.region}권 · ${obj.userData.name}</b><br>기온 ${d.T.toFixed(1)}°C &nbsp; 습도 ${d.RH}%<br>체감온도: <b>${d.hi.toFixed(1)}°C</b><br>단계: <span style="color:${col}">${lv.label}</span><br><span style="opacity:.7;font-size:11px">${lv.act}</span>`;
      } else {
        tip.innerHTML=`<b>${obj.userData.name}</b><br><span style="color:#5a7a95">미조회</span>`;
      }
    } else tip.style.display='none';
  });
  dom.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>{ tip.style.display='none'; });

  function onResize(){
    camera.aspect=W()/H();
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize(W(),H());
  }

  const panel={scene,camera,renderer,registry,onResize};
  MAP3D_PANELS[mountId]=panel;
  ensureAnimLoop3D();
  return panel;
}

function updatePanel3D(panel, dm){
  if(!panel) return;
  Object.keys(panel.registry).forEach(name=>{
    const entry=panel.registry[name];
    const d=dm[name];
    const hi=(d && Number.isFinite(d.hi)) ? d.hi : null;
    const col=new THREE.Color(getColor(hi));
    entry.baseColor.copy(col);
    entry.topMat.color.copy(col);
    entry.sideMat.color.copy(col.clone().multiplyScalar(0.72));
    const h=(hi===null) ? entry.baseDepth : Math.max(entry.baseDepth, 8+Math.max(0,hi-28)*5);
    entry.meshes.forEach(m=>{ m.scale.y=h/entry.baseDepth; m.userData.baseColor=col; m.userData.__data=d||null; });
    if(entry.nameCtl) entry.nameCtl.sprite.position.y=h+8;
    if(entry.tempCtl){
      entry.tempCtl.sprite.position.y=h-6;
      if(hi!==null && hi>=31){
        entry.tempCtl.sprite.visible=true;
        entry.tempCtl.setText(hi.toFixed(1)+'°');
      } else {
        entry.tempCtl.sprite.visible=false;
      }
    }
  });
}

let ANIM3D_STARTED=false;
function ensureAnimLoop3D(){
  if(ANIM3D_STARTED) return;
  ANIM3D_STARTED=true;
  function tick(){
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    Object.values(MAP3D_PANELS).forEach(p=>{ try{ p.renderer.render(p.scene,p.camera); }catch(e){} });
  }
  tick();
}

let CURRENT_MAP_FILTER = 'ALL';

function getFilteredGR(){
  if(CURRENT_MAP_FILTER === 'ALL') return GR;
  return GR.filter(r=>r.region===CURRENT_MAP_FILTER);
}

function disposePanel3D(mountId){
  const p = MAP3D_PANELS[mountId];
  if(!p) return;
  p.scene.traverse(obj=>{
    if(obj.geometry) obj.geometry.dispose();
    if(obj.material){
      const mats = Array.isArray(obj.material) ? obj.material : [obj.material];
      mats.forEach(m=>{ if(m.map) m.map.dispose(); m.dispose(); });
    }
  });
  p.renderer.dispose();
  const mount = document.getElementById(mountId);
  if(mount) mount.innerHTML='';
  delete MAP3D_PANELS[mountId];
}

function changeMapFilter(v){
  CURRENT_MAP_FILTER = v;
  drawMain();
}

function drawMain(){
  const existing = MAP3D_PANELS['map3d-main'];
  if(!existing || existing.filterTag !== CURRENT_MAP_FILTER){
    disposePanel3D('map3d-main');
    const regions = getFilteredGR();
    const panel = initPanel3D('map3d-main', regions, {
      height:14, bevel:1.2, target:900, radius:1120, theta:Math.PI*0.25, phi:Math.PI*0.32,
      baseRadius:1200, fogNear:900, fogFar:2600, sun:[420,620,280], fontSize:21
    });
    if(panel) panel.filterTag = CURRENT_MAP_FILTER;
  }
  const dm={}; for(const d of DATA) if(d.ok) dm[d.name]=d;
  updatePanel3D(MAP3D_PANELS['map3d-main'], dm);
}

function drawInset(mountId, regions, dm){
  if(!MAP3D_PANELS[mountId]){
    initPanel3D(mountId, regions, {
      height:9, bevel:0.6, target:220, radius:250, theta:Math.PI*0.25, phi:Math.PI*0.3,
      baseRadius:220, fogNear:180, fogFar:650, sun:[140,200,90], fontSize:19
    });
  }
  updatePanel3D(MAP3D_PANELS[mountId], dm);
}

function drawAll(){
  const dm={}; for(const d of DATA) if(d.ok) dm[d.name]=d;
  drawMain();
  const jeju=INSET.filter(r=>r.name==='제주시'||r.name==='서귀포');
  const ulleung=INSET.filter(r=>r.name==='울릉');
  if(jeju.length)    drawInset('map3d-jeju', jeju, dm);
  if(ulleung.length) drawInset('map3d-ulleung', ulleung, dm);
}

window.addEventListener('resize', ()=>{
  Object.values(MAP3D_PANELS).forEach(p=>{ if(p.onResize) p.onResize(); });
});

const safeStorage={
  getItem(k){try{return window.localStorage?window.localStorage.getItem(k):null;}catch(e){return null;}},
  setItem(k,v){try{if(window.localStorage)window.localStorage.setItem(k,v);}catch(e){}}
};

function formatBaseLabel(baseTime){
  if(!baseTime)return '—';
  return `${String(baseTime).slice(0,2)}:00`;
}
function getSelectedTime(){
  const el=document.getElementById('targetTime');
  return el?.value || SELECTED_TIME || '1400';
}
function setSelectedTime(v){
  SELECTED_TIME=v||'1400';
  const el=document.getElementById('targetTime');
  if(el)el.value=SELECTED_TIME;
  safeStorage.setItem('kma_target_time',SELECTED_TIME);
}
function formatForecastDateLabel(dateStr){
  if(dateStr && /^\d{8}$/.test(String(dateStr))){
    const m=parseInt(String(dateStr).slice(4,6),10);
    const d=parseInt(String(dateStr).slice(6,8),10);
    return `${m}월 ${d}일`;
  }
  const now=new Date();
  return `${now.getMonth()+1}월 ${now.getDate()}일`;
}
function formatTargetLabel(time=getSelectedTime(), dateStr=null){
  const plan=dateStr?null:getBase();
  const labelDate=dateStr || plan.targetDate;
  return `${formatForecastDateLabel(labelDate)} ${formatBaseLabel(time)} 예보`;
}
function formatPrintDate(dateStr=null){
  return `${formatForecastDateLabel(dateStr)} 일일 기상 현황(폭염)`;
}
function formatLookupTime(d=new Date()){
  return d.toLocaleTimeString('ko-KR',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});
}
function updatePrintHeader(actualInfo=null, lookupTime=null){
  const plan=getBase();
  const info=actualInfo || plan;
  const baseLabel=formatBaseLabel(info.baseTime || plan.baseTime);
  const targetDate=info.targetDate || plan.targetDate;
  const targetLabel=formatTargetLabel(getSelectedTime(), targetDate);
  const lookupLabel=lookupTime || formatLookupTime(new Date());
  const titleEl=document.getElementById('ph-title');
  const metaEl=document.getElementById('ph-time');
  if(titleEl)titleEl.textContent=formatPrintDate(targetDate);
  if(metaEl)metaEl.textContent=`${lookupLabel} 기준 · ${baseLabel} 발표 단기예보 참조 · ${targetLabel}`;
}
function preparePrint(){
  updatePrintHeader(getCurrentBaseInfo());
  drawAll();
}

function getCurrentBaseInfo(){
  const ok=DATA.find(d=>d.ok&&d.baseTime) || RAW_DATA.find(d=>d.ok&&d.baseTime);
  return ok || getBase();
}

function updateBaseGuide(actualInfo=null){
  const plan=getBase();
  const baseTime=actualInfo?.baseTime || plan.baseTime;
  const baseLabel=formatBaseLabel(baseTime);
  const targetLabel=formatTargetLabel();
  const detail=`${targetLabel} 조회 중 · ${baseLabel} 발표자료 기준`;
  const baseEl=document.getElementById('basetime-display');
  const guideEl=document.getElementById('fcstGuide');
  const rankEl=document.getElementById('rankTime');
  if(baseEl){baseEl.style.display='';baseEl.textContent=detail;}
  if(guideEl){
    guideEl.innerHTML=`<span class="fp-k">조회기준</span><strong>${targetLabel}</strong><span class="fp-sep">|</span><span class="fp-k">사용자료</span><strong>${baseLabel} 발표 단기예보</strong>`;
  }
  if(rankEl)rankEl.textContent=`(${formatBaseLabel(getSelectedTime())})`;
  updatePrintHeader(actualInfo);
}

window.onload=()=>{
  const savedTime=safeStorage.getItem('kma_target_time');
  if(savedTime&&HOURLY_HOURS.includes(savedTime))setSelectedTime(savedTime); else setSelectedTime('1400');
  const s=safeStorage.getItem('kma_v5');
  if(s){KEY=s;document.getElementById('apiKey').value=s;activate();loadAll();}
  const refreshClock=()=>{document.getElementById('clock').textContent=new Date().toLocaleString('ko-KR'); updateBaseGuide(getCurrentBaseInfo());};
  refreshClock();
  setInterval(refreshClock,60000);
  setTimeout(drawAll,120);
  window.addEventListener('resize',drawAll);
  if(window.matchMedia){
    const mq=window.matchMedia('print');
    const redraw=()=>setTimeout(drawAll,50);
    if(mq.addEventListener)mq.addEventListener('change',redraw);
    else if(mq.addListener)mq.addListener(redraw);
  }
  window.addEventListener('beforeprint',preparePrint);
};

function activate(){
  document.getElementById('apiBar').style.background='#1a3a1a';
  document.getElementById('apiBar').style.borderBottomColor='#2a6a2a';
  document.getElementById('btnLoad').disabled=false;
  document.getElementById('apiSt').textContent='API 키 설정 완료 ✔';
}
function saveKey(){
  const v=document.getElementById('apiKey').value.trim();
  if(!v){alert('API 키를 입력해주세요.');return;}
  KEY=v;safeStorage.setItem('kma_v5',v);activate();loadAll();
}

function calcHI(T,RH){
  // 기상청 여름철 체감온도 공식(2020 개정)
  // 습구온도(Tw) 산정 후 적용. 기온 25℃ 미만에서는 기온을 그대로 반환.
  if(T<25)return Math.round(T*10)/10;
  // Stull(2011) 습구온도 근사식
  const Tw = T*Math.atan(0.151977*Math.sqrt(RH+8.313659))
    + Math.atan(T+RH) - Math.atan(RH-1.676331)
    + 0.00391838*Math.pow(RH,1.5)*Math.atan(0.023101*RH) - 4.686035;
  const HI = -0.2442 + 0.55399*Tw + 0.45535*T
    - 0.0022*Tw*Tw + 0.00278*Tw*T + 3.0;
  return Math.round(HI*10)/10;
}
function fmtDate(d){
  const p=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');
  return `${d.getFullYear()}${p(d.getMonth()+1)}${p(d.getDate())}`;
}
function fmtYmd(ymd){
  if(!ymd||ymd.length!==8)return ymd||'';
  return `${ymd.slice(0,4)}-${ymd.slice(4,6)}-${ymd.slice(6,8)}`;
}

function getBaseCandidates(now=new Date()){
  // 단기예보 발표시각: 02, 05, 08, 11, 14, 17, 20, 23시
  // 발표 직후 API 반영 지연을 고려하여 10분이 지난 발표자료만 최신 자료로 사용
  const releaseHours=[2,5,8,11,14,17,20,23];
  const availableAt=new Date(now);
  availableAt.setMinutes(availableAt.getMinutes()-10);

  const candidates=[];
  for(let dayOffset=0; dayOffset<=1; dayOffset++){
    const day=new Date(availableAt);
    day.setDate(availableAt.getDate()-dayOffset);
    for(const h of releaseHours){
      const baseDateTime=new Date(day.getFullYear(),day.getMonth(),day.getDate(),h,0,0,0);
      if(baseDateTime<=availableAt){
        candidates.push({
          date:fmtDate(baseDateTime),
          baseTime:String(h).padStart(2,'0')+'00',
          sortTime:baseDateTime.getTime()
        });
      }
    }
  }

  return candidates.sort((a,b)=>b.sortTime-a.sortTime);
}

function getBase(){
  const now=new Date();
  const candidates=getBaseCandidates(now);
  const picked=candidates[0];
  return{
    date:picked.date,
    baseDate:picked.date,
    baseTime:picked.baseTime,
    targetDate:fmtDate(now),
    targetTime:getSelectedTime(),
    candidates
  };
}

function buildHourly(items,targetDate){
  const buckets={};
  for(const it of items){
    if(it.fcstDate!==targetDate || !HOURLY_HOURS.includes(it.fcstTime))continue;
    const key=it.fcstTime;
    if(!buckets[key])buckets[key]={fcstDate:it.fcstDate,fcstTime:it.fcstTime,T:null,RH:null,PCP:null,WSD:null,PTY:null};
    if(it.category==='TMP')buckets[key].T=parseFloat(it.fcstValue);
    if(it.category==='REH')buckets[key].RH=parseFloat(it.fcstValue);
    if(it.category==='PCP')buckets[key].PCP=it.fcstValue; // "강수없음" 또는 "1.0mm" 형태의 문자열
    if(it.category==='WSD')buckets[key].WSD=parseFloat(it.fcstValue);
    if(it.category==='PTY')buckets[key].PTY=it.fcstValue; // 강수형태 코드(0:없음,1:비,2:비/눈,3:눈,4:소나기 등)
  }
  return Object.values(buckets)
    .filter(x=>Number.isFinite(x.T)&&Number.isFinite(x.RH))
    .sort((a,b)=>a.fcstTime.localeCompare(b.fcstTime))
    .map(x=>{
      const hi=calcHI(x.T,x.RH);
      return {...x,hi,lv:getLevel(hi)};
    });
}
const PTY_LABEL={'0':'없음','1':'비','2':'비/눈','3':'눈','4':'소나기','5':'빗방울','6':'빗방울눈날림','7':'눈날림'};

// 목표시간을 포함할 "가능성이 높은" 발표자료부터 먼저 시도하도록 재정렬
// (무작정 최신순 → 실패 → 재시도 방식은 요청 수가 쓸데없이 늘어나 느려짐)
function orderCandidatesForTarget(candidates,targetDate,targetTime){
  const targetNum=parseInt(targetTime,10);
  return candidates
    .map((c,idx)=>{
      const sameDay=c.date===targetDate;
      const baseNum=parseInt(c.baseTime,10);
      let tier;
      if(!sameDay)tier=2;               // 날짜가 다른 후보(전날 발표자료 등) - 최후 순위
      else if(baseNum===targetNum)tier=0; // 목표시간과 발표시각이 정확히 같음 - 가장 신선함
      else if(baseNum<targetNum)tier=1;   // 목표시간 이전 발표자료 - 목표시간 포함 확실
      else tier=3;                        // 목표시간 이후 발표자료 - 포함 불가능(과거 시간 요청)
      return{c,tier,idx};
    })
    .sort((a,b)=>a.tier-b.tier||a.idx-b.idx)
    .map(s=>s.c);
}

async function fetchOne(nx,ny){
  const plan=getBase();
  let lastErr=null;
  let bestFallback=null; // 목표시간은 없지만 그나마 데이터가 있던 후보 (최후 수단)
  const orderedCandidates=orderCandidatesForTarget(plan.candidates,plan.targetDate,plan.targetTime);

  for(const base of orderedCandidates){
    try{
      // numOfRows=1000으로 한 번에 다 받기 (단기예보 한 지점 최대 ~900행)
      const url=`https://apis.data.go.kr/1360000/VilageFcstInfoService_2.0/getVilageFcst?serviceKey=${encodeURIComponent(KEY)}&numOfRows=1000&pageNo=1&dataType=JSON&base_date=${base.date}&base_time=${base.baseTime}&nx=${nx}&ny=${ny}`;
      const res=await fetch(url);if(!res.ok)throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
      const j=await res.json();
      const rc=j?.response?.header?.resultCode;
      if(rc&&rc!=='00')throw new Error(`API오류 ${rc}: ${j?.response?.header?.resultMsg}`);
      const items=j?.response?.body?.items?.item;if(!items||!items.length)throw new Error('no items');

      const hourly=buildHourly(items,plan.targetDate);
      if(hourly.length){
        const hasTarget=hourly.some(h=>h.fcstTime===plan.targetTime);
        console.log('[DEBUG] fetchOne 후보 조회됨',{nx,ny,base:base.baseTime,baseDate:base.date,targetDate:plan.targetDate,targetTime:plan.targetTime,availableFcstTimes:hourly.map(h=>h.fcstTime),hasTarget});
        if(!bestFallback)bestFallback={hourly,baseDate:base.date,baseTime:base.baseTime,targetDate:plan.targetDate};
        if(hasTarget){
          return{
            hourly,
            baseDate:base.date,
            baseTime:base.baseTime,
            targetDate:plan.targetDate
          };
        }
        // 목표시간이 이 발표자료엔 없음 -> 더 이른(과거) 발표자료로 계속 탐색
        lastErr=new Error(`base ${base.baseTime} 발표자료엔 ${plan.targetTime} 없음`);
        continue;
      }

      lastErr=new Error(`no hourly T/RH for ${plan.targetDate} at base ${base.date} ${base.baseTime}`);
      console.warn('[DEBUG] hourly 비어있음',{nx,ny,base:base.baseTime,baseDate:base.date,targetDate:plan.targetDate,itemCount:items.length,sampleFcstDates:[...new Set(items.slice(0,20).map(x=>x.fcstDate))]});
    }catch(e){
      lastErr=e;
      console.error('[DEBUG] fetchOne 후보 실패',{nx,ny,base:base.baseTime,baseDate:base.date,error:e.message});
    }
  }

  if(bestFallback){
    console.warn('[DEBUG] 목표시간 정확히 일치하는 발표자료 없음 → 조회 가능한 최선 자료로 대체',{nx,ny,target:plan.targetTime,availableFcstTimes:bestFallback.hourly.map(h=>h.fcstTime)});
    return bestFallback;
  }
  throw lastErr || new Error('조회 가능한 단기예보 발표자료가 없습니다.');
}

function applySelectedTime(){
  const target=getSelectedTime();
  let mismatchCount=0;
  DATA=RAW_DATA.map(d=>{
    if(!d.ok)return{...d,hi:null,lv:null};
    const h=d.hourly.find(x=>x.fcstTime===target);
    if(!h){
      mismatchCount++;
      if(mismatchCount<=3)console.warn('[DEBUG] 선택시간 불일치',{name:d.name,target,availableFcstTimes:d.hourly.map(x=>x.fcstTime)});
      return{...d,ok:false,hi:null,lv:null,targetTime:target};
    }
    return{
      ...d,
      T:h.T,
      RH:h.RH,
      hi:h.hi,
      lv:h.lv,
      fcstDate:h.fcstDate,
      targetDate:h.fcstDate,
      targetTime:h.fcstTime,
      ok:true
    };
  });
  if(mismatchCount>0)console.log(`[DEBUG] applySelectedTime: ${mismatchCount}개 지역이 선택시간(${target}) 데이터 없음`);
  updateStats();
  drawAll();
  renderTable();
  updateBaseGuide(getCurrentBaseInfo());
  renderWorkPanel();
}

function changeTargetTime(v){
  setSelectedTime(v);
  if(RAW_DATA.length)applySelectedTime();
  else updateBaseGuide();
}

function updateStats(){
  const ok=DATA.filter(d=>d.ok);
  document.getElementById('sT').textContent=ok.length+'개';
  document.getElementById('sD').textContent=ok.filter(d=>d.hi>=33).length+'개';
  document.getElementById('sM').textContent=ok.length?Math.max(...ok.map(d=>d.hi)).toFixed(1)+'°C':'—';
  document.getElementById('sA').textContent=ok.length?(ok.reduce((s,d)=>s+d.hi,0)/ok.length).toFixed(1)+'°C':'—';
}

async function loadAll(){
  if(!KEY){alert('API 키를 먼저 입력해주세요.');return;}
  const btn=document.getElementById('btnLoad');
  btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='⏳ 조회 중...';
  document.getElementById('em').style.display='block';
  document.getElementById('em').textContent=`기상청 시간별 예보 데이터 불러오는 중...`;
  document.getElementById('tbl').style.display='none';

  const all=[...GR,...INSET];
  const results=await Promise.allSettled(all.map(r=>fetchOne(r.nx,r.ny).then(w=>({...r,...w}))));
  RAW_DATA=results.map((res,i)=>{
    if(res.status==='fulfilled')return{...res.value,ok:true};
    return{...all[i],ok:false,hourly:[],error:res.reason?.message||'조회 실패'};
  });

  // 에러 샘플 표시 (디버그용)
  const errs=results.filter(r=>r.status==='rejected').slice(0,1);
  if(errs.length&&!RAW_DATA.filter(d=>d.ok).length){
    alert('조회 실패: '+errs[0].reason?.message+'\n\n브라우저 콘솔(F12)에서 [DEBUG] 로그 확인');
  }

  applySelectedTime();
  btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='🔄 실시간 조회';
  document.getElementById('lu').textContent='업데이트: '+new Date().toLocaleTimeString('ko-KR');
  updatePrintHeader(getCurrentBaseInfo(), new Date().toLocaleTimeString('ko-KR',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}));
}

function renderTable(){
  const list=DATA.filter(d=>d.ok).sort((a,b)=>b.hi-a.hi||regionRank(a.region)-regionRank(b.region)||a.name.localeCompare(b.name,'ko'));
  document.getElementById('em').style.display=list.length?'none':'block';
  document.getElementById('tbl').style.display=list.length?'':'none';
  if(!list.length){document.getElementById('em').textContent='데이터 없음';return;}
  document.getElementById('tbody').innerHTML=list.map((d,i)=>`
    <tr><td style="color:#7a9ab5;font-size:10px">${i+1}</td><td>${d.region}</td><td class="tn">${d.name}</td>
    <td>${d.T.toFixed(1)}°</td><td>${d.RH}%</td>
    <td class="${d.lv.hc}">${d.hi.toFixed(1)}°</td>
    <td><span class="badge ${d.lv.bc}">${d.lv.label}</span></td></tr>`).join('');
}
function getWindLevel(wsd){
  if(!Number.isFinite(wsd))return '-';
  if(wsd>=21)return '강풍경보';
  if(wsd>=14)return '강풍주의보';
  return '정상';
}
function exportCSV(){
  if(!RAW_DATA.length){alert('먼저 날씨 조회를 해주세요.');return;}
  const now=new Date();
  const h=['권역','지역','예보일자','예보시간','기온(°C)','습도(%)','체감온도(°C)','폭염단계','폭염 유의사항','강수형태','강수량(mm)','풍속(m/s)','풍속단계','발표일자','발표시각','내보낸시각'];
  const rows=[];
  RAW_DATA.filter(d=>d.ok).sort((a,b)=>regionRank(a.region)-regionRank(b.region)||a.name.localeCompare(b.name,'ko')).forEach(d=>{
    d.hourly.forEach(x=>{
      rows.push([
        d.region,d.name,fmtYmd(x.fcstDate),formatBaseLabel(x.fcstTime),
        x.T.toFixed(1),x.RH,x.hi.toFixed(1),x.lv.label,x.lv.act,
        x.PTY!=null?(PTY_LABEL[x.PTY]||x.PTY):'-',
        x.PCP??'-',
        Number.isFinite(x.WSD)?x.WSD.toFixed(1):'-',
        getWindLevel(x.WSD),
        fmtYmd(d.baseDate),formatBaseLabel(d.baseTime),now.toLocaleString('ko-KR')
      ]);
    });
  });
  if(!rows.length){alert('내보낼 시간별 데이터가 없습니다.');return;}
  const csv=[h,...rows].map(r=>r.map(v=>`"${String(v??'').replace(/"/g,'""')}"`).join(',')).join('\n');
  const a=document.createElement('a');
  a.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob(['\uFEFF'+csv],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'}));
  a.download=`폭염작업_권역별_시간별예보_${now.toISOString().slice(0,10)}.csv`;a.click();
}

/* ===================== 작업위험 탭 (AIS 작업계획 연동) ===================== */
const REGION_NAMES=[...GR,...INSET].map(g=>g.name);
const PEAK_START=14*60, PEAK_END=17*60; // 14:00~17:00
const INDOOR_PLACES=['국사','고객사','인빌딩','분기국사'];
const INDOOR_POSITIONS=['실내','지하'];
let WORK_ROWS=[];

function extractRegion(address){
  if(!address)return null;
  const tokens=address.split(/\s+/);
  for(const raw of tokens){
    const clean=raw.replace(/(특별자치|광역|자치)?(시|도)$/,'');
    for(const name of REGION_NAMES){
      if(clean===name||clean.startsWith(name)||name.startsWith(clean))return name;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function parseTimeRange(str){
  if(!str)return null;
  const m=str.match(/(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*-\s*(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
  if(!m)return null;
  const start=(+m[1])*60+(+m[2]);
  const end=(+m[3])*60+(+m[4]);
  return{start,end};
}
function overlapsPeak(range){
  if(!range)return false;
  return range.start<PEAK_END && range.end>PEAK_START;
}
function isIndoorWork(place,position){
  return INDOOR_PLACES.includes((place||'').trim())||INDOOR_POSITIONS.includes((position||'').trim());
}
function isHighRiskWork(flag){
  const v=(flag||'').trim();
  return v!==''&&v!=='없음';
}
function getRegionHeatIndex(regionName){
  if(!regionName)return null;
  const d=DATA.find(x=>x.name===regionName);
  if(!d||!d.ok||d.hi==null)return null;
  return d.hi;
}
// 반환: {grade:'safe'|'caution'|'danger'|'critical', label, reason}
function computeWorkRisk(row){
  const region=extractRegion(row['주소']);
  const indoor=isIndoorWork(row['작업장소'],row['작업위치']);
  const highRisk=isHighRiskWork(row['고위험작업']);
  const range=parseTimeRange(row['계획시간']);
  const overlap=overlapsPeak(range);
  const hi=getRegionHeatIndex(region);

  if(indoor)return{grade:'safe',label:'✅ 안전',reason:'실내 작업',region,hi};
  if(hi==null)return{grade:'unknown',label:'⏳ 미조회',reason:'체감온도 미조회 지역',region,hi};

  if(hi<33)return{grade:'safe',label:'✅ 안전',reason:`체감 ${hi.toFixed(1)}° (정상)`,region,hi};
  if(hi<35){
    if(highRisk)return{grade:'caution',label:'⚠️ 주의',reason:`체감 ${hi.toFixed(1)}° + 고위험작업(${row['고위험작업']})`,region,hi};
    return{grade:'safe',label:'✅ 안전',reason:`체감 ${hi.toFixed(1)}° (주의보 단계, 저위험작업)`,region,hi};
  }
  if(hi<38){
    if(highRisk&&overlap)return{grade:'danger',label:'🚨 위험',reason:`체감 ${hi.toFixed(1)}° + 고위험작업 + 14~17시 작업`,region,hi};
    if(highRisk)return{grade:'caution',label:'⚠️ 주의',reason:`체감 ${hi.toFixed(1)}° + 고위험작업(시간대 안겹침)`,region,hi};
    return{grade:'caution',label:'⚠️ 주의',reason:`체감 ${hi.toFixed(1)}° (경보 단계)`,region,hi};
  }
  // hi>=38
  if(highRisk&&overlap)return{grade:'critical',label:'🚨🚨 고위험',reason:`체감 ${hi.toFixed(1)}° + 고위험작업 + 14~17시 작업`,region,hi};
  if(highRisk)return{grade:'danger',label:'🚨 위험',reason:`체감 ${hi.toFixed(1)}° + 고위험작업(시간대 안겹침)`,region,hi};
  return{grade:'caution',label:'⚠️ 주의',reason:`체감 ${hi.toFixed(1)}° (중대경보 단계)`,region,hi};
}

function handleWorkFile(evt){
  const file=evt.target.files[0];
  if(!file)return;
  document.getElementById('workFileStatus').textContent='⏳ 파싱 중...';
  Papa.parse(file,{
    header:true,
    skipEmptyLines:true,
    encoding:'UTF-8',
    complete:(res)=>{
      WORK_ROWS=res.data.filter(r=>r['공사작업번호']||r['주소']);
      document.getElementById('workFileStatus').textContent=`✅ ${WORK_ROWS.length}건 로드됨 (${file.name})`;
      renderWorkPanel();
      showRpTab('work');
    },
    error:(err)=>{
      document.getElementById('workFileStatus').textContent='❌ 파싱 실패: '+err.message;
    }
  });
}

function riskSortKey(g){
  return{critical:0,danger:1,caution:2,unknown:3,safe:4}[g]??9;
}

function renderWorkPanel(){
  const wrap=document.getElementById('workListWrap');
  const emptyEl=document.getElementById('workEmpty');
  const listEl=document.getElementById('workList');
  if(!WORK_ROWS.length){
    emptyEl.style.display='block';
    emptyEl.textContent='우측 상단 "📂 작업계획 업로드"로 AIS CSV를 올려주세요';
    listEl.innerHTML='';
    ['wCritical','wDanger','wCaution','wSafe'].forEach(id=>document.getElementById(id).textContent='—');
    return;
  }
  const computed=WORK_ROWS.map(r=>({row:r,risk:computeWorkRisk(r)}));
  const counts={critical:0,danger:0,caution:0,safe:0,unknown:0};
  computed.forEach(c=>counts[c.risk.grade]=(counts[c.risk.grade]||0)+1);
  document.getElementById('wCritical').textContent=counts.critical+'건';
  document.getElementById('wDanger').textContent=counts.danger+'건';
  document.getElementById('wCaution').textContent=counts.caution+'건';
  document.getElementById('wSafe').textContent=(counts.safe+counts.unknown)+'건';

  const sorted=computed.slice().sort((a,b)=>riskSortKey(a.risk.grade)-riskSortKey(b.risk.grade));
  const gradeColor={critical:'#e53935',danger:'#fb8c00',caution:'#ffd93d',safe:'#5ab4e8',unknown:'#7a9ab5'};
  const shown=sorted.filter(c=>c.risk.grade!=='safe'); // 기본은 위험군만 노출
  emptyEl.style.display='none';
  if(!shown.length){
    listEl.innerHTML='<div style="padding:14px;color:#7a9ab5;font-size:12px">현재 시간 기준 위험 작업이 없습니다 (안전 작업 '+counts.safe+'건 제외 표시)</div>';
    return;
  }
  listEl.innerHTML=shown.map(c=>{
    const r=c.row,k=c.risk;
    return `<div style="border-left:3px solid ${gradeColor[k.grade]};background:#1e3348;border-radius:5px;padding:8px 10px;margin:0 12px 8px">
      <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#fff">
        <span>${k.label}</span><span style="color:#7a9ab5;font-weight:600">${r['계획시간']||'-'}</span>
      </div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:#c0d5e8;margin-top:3px">${(r['센터/지사/법인']||'')} ${(r['팀명']||'')} · ${k.region||'미분류'}</div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:#c0d5e8">${r['공사작업명']||r['공사작업내용']||''}</div>
      <div style="font-size:10px;color:#8aa0b8;margin-top:3px">${k.reason}</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

function showRpTab(tab){
  const rankBtn=document.getElementById('tabBtnRank'),workBtn=document.getElementById('tabBtnWork');
  const rankPanel=document.getElementById('rpRankPanel'),workPanel=document.getElementById('rpWorkPanel');
  if(tab==='work'){
    rankPanel.style.display='none';
    workPanel.style.display='flex';
    workBtn.style.color='#fff';workBtn.style.borderBottomColor='#1a5a9a';
    rankBtn.style.color='#7a9ab5';rankBtn.style.borderBottomColor='transparent';
  }else{
    workPanel.style.display='none';
    rankPanel.style.display='block';
    rankBtn.style.color='#fff';rankBtn.style.borderBottomColor='#1a5a9a';
    workBtn.style.color='#7a9ab5';workBtn.style.borderBottomColor='transparent';
  }
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
